tools_problematic.problem: Spurious '[WARN] MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md exists with content but mapping has no defer rows — check consistency' on a zero-deferral migration.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log TURN 33 and TURN 35 both print the WARN even though there are no defer rows and the migration is otherwise fully PASS.

tool_limitations.limitation: Its 'no defer rows' PASS branch only fires when MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md contains the literal string 'No items deferred', but the bootstrap that writes the file never emits that string (it writes '| (none) | — |').
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Make the bootstrap emit the sentinel the validator recognizes so the empty-deferral case PASSes instead of WARNing.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Validator FAILed once on 4 rows at Status=copied, and emitted a DEFERRED.md-consistency WARN.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: 1 retry to flip statuses; the WARN was never resolvable by the agent (it is a script contradiction, not an agent action).
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Bootstrap writes MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md without the 'No items deferred' sentinel that the validator's empty-case PASS branch requires.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Status FAIL fixed by flipping copied→done; the WARN persisted harmlessly.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Aligning Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1's empty-deferral output with the validator's expected sentinel.
